name: livio-legal-crm
description: Fundação segura e multiempresa para um CRM jurídico.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @livio/shared && npm run build -w @livio/db && npm run build -w @livio/ui && npm run build -w @livio/api && npm run build -w @livio/web
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @livio/shared && npm run build -w @livio/db && npm run build -w @livio/ui
scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @livio/api" "npm run dev -w @livio/web"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:packages && npm run dev -w @livio/api
scripts.dev:web: npm run build -w @livio/ui && npm run dev -w @livio/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck -w @livio/api && npm run typecheck -w @livio/web
scripts.db:migrate:dev: node tools/supabase/safety.mjs local-reset && supabase db reset
scripts.db:migrate:deploy: node tools/supabase/safety.mjs remote-migrate && supabase db push --linked
scripts.db:studio: node tools/supabase/safety.mjs database-tool && prisma studio --schema packages/db/prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.db:seed:local: node tools/supabase/safety.mjs local-reset && supabase db reset
